INSERT INTO access.realm_residency (tenant_id, realm_id, version, region, class, domain_id, decision_pos)
         SELECT $1, $2,
                COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.realm_residency
                           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2), 0) + 1,
                $3, $4, $5, $6
